analysis: The PR modifies only docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The visible change (base line 564 / head 564) adds two benchmark flags, `--runtime-concurrency <sizes>` and `--runtime-stagger`, plus the `RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark` reference, to the Runtime generation row. The document states the benchmark keeps the prefix cache off. A second head range (1208-1209) appears in the range map, but the patch excerpt is truncated and I could not see it. The base text units end at line 830 and 404 of the earlier unit, so those lines are not visible. The documentation change itself alters no security controls. The benchmark is a developer/operator CLI mode that uses production slot engines with the prefix cache disabled. That does not touch the T-041 cache tiers, their gates, TTL, or HMAC lookup tags. I could not verify the unseen head lines or the underlying Swift implementation (BenchmarkCommand, RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark). If the code behind the new flags introduces input parsing for `<sizes>`, resource exhaustion from concurrency, or cache enablement, it needs separate review. The documentation does not state any of these. No threat-model assumptions are invalidated by the visible text. The remaining uncertainty is the truncated 1208-1209 range, which I could not inspect.
